reason: My Booking and Airbnb scheduled messages and the printed house-rules sheet already answer the Wi-Fi and parking questions. I am not handing my guests to a chatbot from a new little company I have never heard of, even if it is only €20 a month.
objection: If this one person gets sick or closes the company in July, my guests get wrong answers in their language and the bad review lands on me, not on them.
would_change_my_mind: A host I know on this coast using it for a whole season and telling me the guests liked it and it never embarrassed her.
